newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt trade halts due to technical problems.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt trade halts due to technical problems.

text.p: Trading on the Frankfurt stock exchange has been halted indefinitely due to technical problems, a bourse spokeswoman said on Friday.
The breakdown occured at around 0815 GMT during the pre-bourse IBIS electronic trade session and there was no indication when the problem would be rectified, the spokeswoman said.
"At present, nothing is working," she said.
The DTB Deutsche Terminboerse futures and options exchange was unaffected.
